detail.longDescription: 🛠️ UNIX philosophy in modern infrastructure: Write programs that do one thing and do it well. Before adding heavy SaaS monitoring agents that consume 200MB RAM, simple POSIX systemd journalctl, stdout logging, and lightweight curl health probes can run for years without crashing. Reliability is a function of simplicity. # linux # unix # foss # selfhosted # homelab # sysadmin # indieweb
